title: 第1169章 表演盛宴吴雪真成天才少女了第1168章 天赋画术
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
表演盛宴，吴雪真成天才少女了！非常多的视频，都是相关行业大佬们对吴雪的点评。
看上去都是大佬们自发出来点评的，拍摄的风格也像是中途采访。
但林默知道，应该是郭元和燕花动用了自己所有的人脉资源请这些大佬拍摄的采访视频。
刷到的第一个视频是宋知远。
他是龙国美院油画系教授，教学时长二十二年，是当代知名油画家，他还活着，但他的画已经卖出过几百万的高价。
这就是权威。
采访的地点是大学内，他刚刚下课，正准备离开，就被记者拦下了。
镜头晃动，记者焦急的问道：“宋教授，您有关注最近在网路爆火的那位女画家吗？您被网友奉为美术圈毒舌教父，你能出来评价几句吗？”
宋知远愣了一下，然后微微仰头思考了一会后才感慨道：“我当然看了，我又不是什么老古董，我还花了两天时间去分析她的画，去分析那幅画的构图。
想要找一个攻击点。
你知道，我的爱好就是喜欢看新人哭。
研究之后我非常感兴趣，我还画了十二张草图，把每一根线条的走向都用红笔标出来。
但”
宋知远耸耸肩：“但我在第二天晚上就放弃了。”
“哦？！”记者发出一声惊叹：“是因为太简单了，不值得研究吗？”
“那倒不是，”宋知远摆摆手：“因为我在研究复刻的时候，发现那幅画的每一根线条都在拒绝被分析。
它们不服从任何透视法，也不遵循任何黄金分割，就连好不好看都不在乎。
可是呢，当它们放在一起的时候，就完全不一样了！
我教了二十二年怎么画出一幅好画，可这个孩子画出来的东西，跟我教的所有东西都没有关系。
它就像是从地底下长出来的一样，没有人能够教出这样的东西。

我只能说，她的画术是上天赋予的。
真是该死的天才！”
宋知远说到这，咬牙切齿，好像什么有趣味的事情被打断了。
但很快他又摇头唏嘘道：“天才真是不讲道理啊，如果有机会能够接触她，我真想问问她画画的时候到底在想什么。
好了，不要再问了，我是嫉妒这些天才的，再问下去我怕我骂娘。”
说完，宋知远迈着大步快速离开，就像是逃离烈日一样。
镜头一直拍他的背影。
看完视频，林默也乐了。
宋知远这个人林默也听说过，以毒舌出名，每次评判新时代画家时，都会把对方批的一文不值，甚至有把人喷退圈的经历。
果然，评论区对于宋知远的评价十分的意外。
“不是吧，宋舌头竟然给出了正面的评价？”
“哈哈哈，我看宋老头是真的被吴雪的话折服了，不然他不可能说的这么收敛的。”
“笑死我了，老头一直抓着天才这个词不放啊，乾脆说吴雪在她妈妈肚子里的时候就是大画家了呗。”
林默看了一下发布时间。
宋知远的采访是在吴雪视频爆火后的两天。
其他名人视频是在宋知远的视频火了之后也跟着火。
林默一下子就明白了郭元的操作，利用宋知远制造出圈的社会话题，让这个事件更上一层热度。
content_en:
A feast of performances, Wu Xue has truly become a genius girl! There are a lot of videos that are comments about Wu Xue by big guys in related industries.
It seems that all the big guys came out to comment on their own initiative, and the shooting style was like an interview midway through.
But Lin Mo knew that it was Guo Yuan and Yan Hua who used all their personal resources to ask these big guys to shoot the interview videos.
The first video I saw was of Song Zhiyuan.
He is a professor at the Oil Painting Department of the Longguo Academy of Fine Arts. He has been teaching for 22 years. He is a well-known contemporary oil painter. He is still alive, but his paintings have sold for millions.
This is authority.
The interview took place in the university. He had just finished class and was about to leave when he was stopped by the reporter.
The camera shook and the reporter asked anxiously: "Professor Song, have you paid attention to the female painter who has become popular on the Internet recently? You are regarded by netizens as the godfather of the art circle with a vicious tongue. Can you comment on it?"
Song Zhiyuan was stunned for a moment, then raised his head slightly and thought for a while before sighing: "Of course I saw it, I'm not an old antique, I spent two days analyzing her painting and the composition of that painting.
Want to find an attack point.
You know, my hobby is watching new people cry.
After researching, I was very interested. I also drew twelve sketches and marked the direction of each line with a red pen.
But”
Song Zhiyuan shrugged: "But I gave up on the second night."
"Oh?!" the reporter exclaimed: "Is it because it is too simple and not worth studying?"
"That's not true," Song Zhiyuan waved his hand: "Because when I was studying the reproduction, I found that every line of the painting refused to be analyzed.
They don't obey any perspective, they don't follow any golden section, they don't even care whether they look good or not.
But, when they are put together, they are completely different!
I have been teaching how to draw a good painting for twenty-two years, but what this child drew has nothing to do with anything I taught him.
It's like it grew out of the ground, and no one can teach it.
All I can say is that her painting skills were given by God.
What a damn genius! "
When Song Zhiyuan said this, he gritted his teeth, as if something interesting had been interrupted.
But soon he shook his head and sighed: "Genius is really unreasonable. If I have the opportunity to meet her, I really want to ask her what she is thinking when she is painting.
Okay, don’t ask any more. I’m jealous of these geniuses. If I ask any more, I’m afraid I’ll scold them. "
After saying that, Song Zhiyuan left quickly with long strides, as if fleeing from the scorching sun.
The camera kept filming his back.
After watching the video, Lin Mo was also happy.
Lin Mo had also heard of Song Zhiyuan, who was famous for his venomous tongue. Every time he judged new era painters, he would criticize them as worthless, and even had the experience of expelling people from the circle.
Sure enough, the comment section was very surprised by Song Zhiyuan's evaluation.
"No, Song Tongue actually gave a positive comment?"
"Hahaha, I think Old Man Song was really impressed by Wu Xue's words, otherwise he wouldn't have been so restrained."
"I'm laughing so hard. The old man keeps insisting on the word genius. Let's just say Wu Xue was a great painter when she was in her mother's womb."
Lin Mo looked at the release time.
Song Zhiyuan’s interview came two days after Wu Xue’s video went viral.
Other celebrity videos became popular after Song Zhiyuan’s video went viral.
Lin Mo immediately understood Guo Yuan's operation, using Song Zhiyuan to create social topics outside the circle, making the incident even more popular.
